society.skycraft.say.region.shadowfen: Ash-stained fens, pitcher-bogs, and broken-chain cairns mark Shadowfen along the northern border from Stormhold's road to Thorn.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.1: Shadowfen is the north-western border mire where Morrowind's ash-runoff meets Argonia's deep peat: a scarred frontier of broken slaver chains, mud-stilt villages, sunken step-pyramids, and vigilant border-tribes watching every road down from Deshaan.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.2: Here former Dres captives and Tree-Minders guard the Percolating Mire and Alten Corimont against smuggling rings that still try to spirit hatchlings north across the hills.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.3: Beneath the pitcher bogs and cypress knees lie Barsaebic Ayleid ruins and the twin-peaked xanmeer of Ten-Maur-Wolk, where water-locks still answer the old calendar.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.4: Here in Shadowfen, the land is shaped by limestone sinkholes and low basalt spurs along the Morrowind march, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.5: Watch the sky when warm marsh fog carrying fine grey ash from the northern hills sets in across Shadowfen—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.6: Our people draw their living along slow dark channels draining the northern border, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.7: Don't stray far into carnivorous flora, fleshflies, and bog dogs after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.8: The markets of Shadowfen turn on marsh reagents, reed basketry, and bog-iron spears, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.9: From mud-and-stilt villages around border Hist trees, led by Alten Corimont and Forsaken Hamlet, the watch-horns carry clear across raised acid peat beds between the channels.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.10: Ask anyone in Shadowfen who holds the reins and they'll point you to freed slave families and vigilant marsh scouts.
society.skycraft.say.shadowfen.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of rusted slaver irons hung on boundary trees as a warning and memorial.

society.skycraft.say.region.gideon: Along the western levee plain above the Niben marshes, Gideon's stone ramparts blend Imperial masonry with Lukiul and An-Xileel custom.
society.skycraft.say.gideon.1: Gideon is the western reed-plain bordering Cyrodiil's Blackwood: a country of wide sawgrass prairies, Niben overflow marshes, half-drowned Imperial causeways, and fortified stone manors left from the Colovian and Septim occupations.

society.skycraft.say.gideon.4: Here in Gideon, the land is shaped by broad silt levees and low clay islands along the Blackwood frontier, and every traveler learns to read the ground.

society.skycraft.say.gideon.7: Don't stray far into tall sawgrass, bog dogs, and marsh nix after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.gideon.8: The markets of Gideon turn on wetland rice, reed rafts, and Blackwood border trade, and every caravan counts the weight twice.

society.skycraft.say.murkmire.5: Our people draw their living along calm lagoon channels and submerged root-ways, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.6: Don't stray far into towering mangrove arches, hackwings, and Voriplasm fens after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.7: The markets of Murkmire turn on shell-lime pottery, Bright-Throat carvings, and rare venoms, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.8: From Soulrest's stilt-harbour and painted tribal rings around Hist mounds, the watch-horns carry clear across drowned limestone karst and stepped xanmeer foundations along the southern shelf.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.9: Ask anyone in Murkmire who holds the reins and they'll point you to rival hunter and singer tribes plus Shadowscale mentors.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.10: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of honoring Duskfall and the seasonal turning of change.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.11: Tempers run sharp over tribal contest over a waking pre-Duskfall blood-oracle whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through Murkmire.
society.skycraft.say.murkmire.12: Give a wide berth to the Teeth of Sithis and Xul-Thuxis stepped pyramids descending into subterranean seas—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
